issues.description: Field 'firstName' in the Person entity has inconsistent types across artifacts. In the template repository Person.java the field is declared as 'private String firstName' (used by tests via setFirstName("Max")). In the solution repository Person.java the field is declared as 'private int firstName', while its getter/setter and equals/hashCode still treat it as a String in the surrounding code. This mismatch causes a compilation error and prevents students from running or extending the project and from using provided tests which expect a String firstName.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the 'firstName' attribute type consistent with the template and tests by changing the declaration in src/main/java/de/tum/in/ase/eist/model/Person.java in the solution repository to 'private String firstName'. Also ensure the getter and setter signatures (getFirstName()/setFirstName(String)) and equals()/hashCode() use String consistently. Rebuild and run the test suite to confirm compilation and behavior are restored.
